Hi, I’m Aditya 👋

I’m a Computer Science and Engineering student at VIT Vellore, specialising in Blockchain Technology, with a strong interest in building intelligent and scalable solutions for real-world problems.

My technical interests include Blockchain, Smart Contracts, Decentralised Systems, AI & Generative AI, Python, and Java. I’m also exploring emerging tools, technologies, and prompt engineering frameworks to build smarter and more efficient applications.

I believe in learning by building — experimenting with new technologies, developing practical projects, and continuously improving my problem-solving and technical skills.

Exploring. Building. Learning. Innovating.

research.title: An AI-Powered Adaptive Framework for Banking Fraud Detection and Risk-Based Authentication with Blockchain-Enabled Auditability
research.topic: AI-Based Bank Fraud Detection & Risk Authentication System
research.author: Aditya Raj
research.abstract: The rapid growth of digital banking has made fraud increasingly complex and challenging to detect using traditional static rule-based methods. This research proposes an AI-powered adaptive framework that analyzes transaction behavior, location, device telemetry, and historical user activity to identify suspicious patterns and assign dynamic risk levels. Based on the calculated risk score, the system executes tiered responses: low-risk transactions are approved frictionlessly, medium-risk triggers step-up multi-factor authentication (OTP/Biometrics), and high-risk transactions are immediately blocked. A permissioned blockchain layer immutably records decision hashes, risk scores, and model explanation tokens, establishing a tamper-evident audit trail for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution without exposing sensitive customer banking data.
research.problemStatement: Traditional banking fraud detection relies heavily on static rule engines that produce high false-positive rates and route up to 65% of transactions to manual investigation queues taking 24 to 48 hours. Moreover, centralized AI decision-making lacks immutable proof of decision integrity, leaving records vulnerable to tampering or retrospective alterations during audit disputes.
keyContributions: Separation of Responsibilities: AI provides high-throughput real-time anomaly intelligence, while a permissioned blockchain guarantees immutable auditability and non-repudiation.
Dynamic Multi-Tiered Authentication: Implements dynamic risk scoring (0–100) transitioning from zero-friction instant approvals to adaptive step-up MFA/Biometrics and automated blocks.

Zero-PII On-Chain Storage: Sensitive customer and banking data remains safely in bank databases; only cryptographic SHA-256 decision hashes, model explanation tokens, and timestamps are recorded on the distributed ledger.
Rapid Real-Time Resolution: Reduces transaction verification delays from 24–48 hours down to sub-second real-time inference with projected 95% fraud detection accuracy.

architectureSteps.title: Banking Transaction Ingestion
architectureSteps.description: Captures multidimensional payload parameters: transaction amount, timestamp, device fingerprint, geolocation, velocity, and account history.

architectureSteps.title: Data Preprocessing & Behavioral Baseline
architectureSteps.description: Performs feature scaling, customer spending profile verification, and contextual anomaly isolation against historical spending baselines.

architectureSteps.title: AI/ML Fraud Classifier & Risk Engine
architectureSteps.description: Ensemble ML & Deep Learning neural network evaluates pattern vectors to predict fraud probability and generate a normalized risk score (0–100).

architectureSteps.title: Adaptive Risk-Based Triaging
architectureSteps.description: Directs transaction into 3 distinct policy pathways: Low Risk (Frictionless Approval), Medium Risk (MFA/OTP/Biometrics), High Risk (Immediate Block & Flag).

architectureSteps.title: Cryptographic Hash Generation
architectureSteps.description: Generates immutable SHA-256 hash digest combining transaction ID, AI risk score, decision timestamp, and explainability reasoning vector.

architectureSteps.title: Permissioned Blockchain Smart Contract Ledger
architectureSteps.description: Commits cryptographic decision proof onto a permissioned distributed ledger, sealing transaction auditability against post-facto alterations.

architectureSteps.title: Integrity Verification & Compliance Audit
architectureSteps.description: Allows bank auditors, compliance officers, and forensic investigators to verify decision integrity instantly without compromising customer privacy.
